visual_identity.core_identity: A low insectoid dungeon scavenger recognized by extremely long sensory antennae, armored body, four legs, and metal-corroding feeding behavior.
visual_identity.silhouette: Low four-legged arthropod-like body, arched armored back, extremely long feeler antennae sweeping forward, tapered tail.
visual_identity.head_features: Small blunt head with simple mandibles and very long segmented antennae.
visual_identity.body_shape: Compact low body on four sturdy legs with plated back and flexible tail.
visual_identity.limb_structure: Exactly four sturdy walking legs; two extremely long antennae project from the head. No six-leg insect anatomy.
visual_identity.surface: Broad armor plates with restrained seam lines; antennae kept clean and readable.
